system.description: Sacrificial Baiting: Once per rest you can stun one of your Spaceship's components to negate incoming damage. Stun the Cannons: you can't attack whilst stunned. Stun the Spaceship Core: you can't move whilst stunned. To end the effect, you can make a Power Roll (15).

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
